title: HR Recruitment Executive
description: GoFam Warrior Academy · Chennai · In person I’m Coach Bala. My wife Nikki, our daughters Tara and Sasha, and I founded GoFam to help families get stronger and enjoy moving together. At GoFam Warrior Academy, we bring that mission to life through KRAVANA, our training method combining Krav Maga, Animal Flow and calisthenics. We’re looking for an HR Executive to work directly with me as we build our Chennai team. Your first priority will be to help us hire 20 trainee fitness trainers. Once they join, you’ll help them settle in, understand what’s expected of them and have someone they can turn to when they need support. What you’ll do Run recruitment from first contact to joining. Write job posts, build relationships with Chennai colleges and fitness communities, screen applicants, coordinate practical auditions with me and follow up on offers. We’re looking for freshers who train consistently and respond well to coaching. Help us reach more women interested in coaching careers. Build relationships with placement cells, sports clubs and local coaches who can introduce us to candidates. Use consistent selection criteria across applicants. Guide new hires through their first 90 days. Organise onboarding, explain the training schedule and certification milestones, and check in regularly. If a trainee is struggling, help them raise it early and agree on a next step with their mentor. Support the team day to day. Maintain employee records, attendance and leave. Listen to concerns, handle sensitive conversations with discretion and follow through on what was agreed. Keep the founders informed. Share a short weekly update on hiring progress, upcoming assessments and people issues that need attention. Use what you learn to improve the next round of hiring. Who we’d love to meet We’d ideally like someone with 2–4 years of hands-on experience in recruitment and HR operations. You can run a hiring drive, keep a simple tracker up to date and have a thoughtful conversation with someone who needs help. Familiarity with Chennai’s local hiring networks and comfort communicating in Tamil and English would be valuable. You’ll have room to shape how a growing startup hires, welcomes and supports its people. We want colleagues to feel the same care on their first day that we expect them to show the families who train with us. How to apply Send your CV and a short note about one role you helped fill and one example of how you supported an employee after they joined. We’d like to hear what you did and what you learned. Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month Application Question(s): Are you a people person? Work Location: In person
